ancestries.name: Kitsune
ancestries.description: Shape-shifting fox-folk who can appear as humans or their true fox-eared form, known for their trickery and adaptability.

ancestries.name: Tengu
ancestries.description: Crow-like bird-folk with a love for storytelling, blades, and a curse that makes them obsessed with collecting shiny objects.

ancestries.name: Leshy
ancestries.description: Small, sentient plants given life by primal magic, with bodies made of leaves, vines, fungi, or flowers.

ancestries.name: Lizardfolk
ancestries.description: Ancient reptilian people who ruled the world before the age of humans, with powerful jaws and a deep connection to nature.
